data: group_lingam_metrics.csv: one row per fit (220 fits = ours 2 regimes x 6 sizes x 10 seeds + GroupLiNGAM 2 regimes x 5 sizes x 10 seeds); every fit status 'ok', no timeouts or errors
figure: group_lingam_sample_sizes.pdf (stable above unstable, n <= 5000); companion table group_lingam_sample_sizes_table.md
run_branch: claude/grouplingam-experiment-results-38c790 (git_revision values in the CSV refer to its commits)

git_revisions.e03fa14: both methods at n <= 1000, ours at n = 2000 and 10000; serial
git_revisions.21ba180: ours at n = 5000, 4 seeds per regime (limit 86400 s); 4 concurrent slots
git_revisions.a1b3fc7: GroupLiNGAM at n = 5000 and ours at n = 5000, remaining 6 seeds per regime; 4 concurrent fits

source_files: benchmark_group_lingam.py, benchmark.py and graph.py are byte-identical to this commit (see source_sha256 in the per-fit JSONs). lingd.py later changed on main only in the candidate-enumeration path; FastICA and Hungarian selection, which this benchmark uses, are unchanged, and a rerun of stable n=100 seed 0 on main reproduces both methods' results exactly.
datasets: Regenerated by rule synth_generate (regime, d=10, num_cycles=4, density=0.5, samp_size, seed; Laplace noise); dataset_sha256 per fit is in the CSV. Regeneration on main was checked byte-identical for three cells.

environment.host: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X (16 cores / 32 threads), 123 GiB RAM, Linux 6.17.0-35-generic; shared with another user's jobs

protocol: Time limits (s): n=100: 600, 500: 600, 1000: 1800, 2000: 7200, 5000: 86400 (raised from 21600 before the n=5000 launch), 10000: 86400; both methods get the same limit at each n.
n <= 2000: one fit at a time. An earlier 8-concurrent-fit run slowed GroupLiNGAM about 3.6x at n=1000 and caused false timeouts; it was discarded, not merged.
n = 5000: 4 concurrent single-threaded fits, so GroupLiNGAM times at n=5000 are inflated by contention relative to the serial points (median about 11 h per fit).
The server rebooted once during the serial run (2026-09-24 12:57); the run resumed with the same commit, config and packages, and the interrupted fit was rerun from scratch.
GroupLiNGAM was not run at n = 10000 (extrapolated to take days per fit); ours at n = 10000 is in the CSV but outside the figure.
